steps.text: The setting sun seems to be the last customer of the small shop. The one behind the counter is no longer a familiar old man, but a coffee-colored creature.
It cranks a grinder handle, and the aroma of coffee wafts into the air with bits and pieces of finely ground beans.
A record spins slowly as a loudspeaker sings leisurely.

steps.name: Coffee-colored Creature
steps.text: Oh, welcome.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I don't think I saw you earlier. Are you new here?

steps.name: Coffee-colored Creature
steps.text: I think so, because I don't have any memories from yesterday. I don't know why I'm here, but I thought I'd make a cup of coffee... Oh, would you like one?

steps.name: Coffee-colored Creature
steps.text: Coffee has a nimbly wonderful flavor that comes only when you brew by hand. Now let's see... where did I put those newly arrived beans? I should have stored them myself...

steps.name: Coffee-colored Creature
steps.text: Seems like it's behind some kind of guitar. Hm... talk of guitars is suddenly making me a little angry. How odd, what's got my heart frazzling?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Guitar? Angry? Are you okay?

steps.name: Coffee-colored Creature
steps.text: Never mind. Maybe it's because that guitar looks a bit boring.

steps.name: Coffee-colored Creature
steps.text: Please, sit anywhere you like. The one you're waiting for will soon be here.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The one I'm waiting for...?

steps.name: Coffee-colored Creature
steps.text: Are you waiting? Or is the other? I can't tell.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Oh, you're here.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I... remember you.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Good evening, Adele. So sorry I'm late—did you remember to have breakfast today?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Yes, I did.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Huh? Why do you ask?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Good girl.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: You've changed your clothes. are you ready?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Clothes...? Huh, isn't this Mutti's coat...?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Pack your things and let's go shopping. We'll go buy some things we need to climb a volcano.
The sun inches down bit by bit as the streetlamps along the path light up like stars. Adele's vision is a little fuzzy, as if she has seen a sky like this somewhere, sometime before.
Was there a short street in that small town on Leithanien's southern border, or on the road back home from her school in her memories?
She can even remember the smell of the air then. Slightly moist, with a hint of sunshine and plants growing, exactly the same as now.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Is this your shopping mall?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Yes. We have to make some preparations before we climb the volcano.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I know there's many things we need to bring. A compass, protective clothing, a camera... A tent and some flint too, if we're camping overnight.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: No, we won't need those in here.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: First, we need to buy enough 'knowledge,' 'courage,' and 'curiosity.' Check the prices before buying one of each, and lastly buy a little 'luck.'

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: But 'luck' is very expensive, and often the fastest to sell out, so it's alright to skip it if you don't have the budget.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I see...
The fluffy creature shakes itself, and several soda bottle caps fall from her wool. They clink and tinkle into the merchant's pouch.

steps.name: Shrewd Creature
steps.text: Thank you for your generosity!

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Hm... I may need to buy a bit more 'courage.'

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: I have enough 'courage' to climb the volcano, but I need a bit more 'courage' to leave home.
The fluffy critter shakes itself again, more caps falling out. The merchant opens its pouch, waiting for more.

steps.name: Shrewd Creature
steps.text: Not enough, not enough.

steps.name: Shrewd Creature
steps.text: If the pouch isn't full, I can't give you 'courage,' if the pouch isn't full.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: If you don't manage to buy 'courage', will you be able to climb the volcano?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: It's alright, Adele. Things like this happen all the time. I've gradually become used to finding 'courage' by and for myself.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Adele, let's get moving. We must be careful on our journey, and look after our things well.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Things? But I didn't bring anything with me.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Someone wants to steal the 'photograph.'

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Follow me, and keep an eye on my package, okay?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What did you just say? I didn't catch that...

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: We can't go on like this Adele. Here, for you.
The cuddly creature shakes itself, and a fluff of wool falls out.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What's this...?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Go on, put it on your ear, and you'll be able to hear.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Now, we have to find the next one.
There is yet another fluffy critter covering a window in front of him with photographs. He turns his head at the sound of footsteps.
His fluffy back fidgets repeatedly, covering the window full of photos.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Oh, um... you two... you're finally here.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: We have much to prepare. How's the weather looking?

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: The sky is full of thick clouds, I'm afraid it might rain soon.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Do we still have time?

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Not much left. We'll need to hurry.
Adele looks at the sky without a cloud in sight.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Do you need me to buy an umbrella?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: No, Adele. Look, I'm an umbrella.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: We can't let the 'photograph' get wet, or be stolen. I'll keep it safe in my package.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What is this 'photograph' you're talking about?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Shh. I hope you never find out.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: And if you do, that it happens far, far in the future.
The solemn creature lowers his head.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Let's go. We'll head upwards in a bit, and that's where we want to go.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: You don't have enough wool yet, Adele. here, this is mine.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Eh...? O-Okay.
The two creatures seem to have shrunk a little, and Adele looks just like one of them.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Um... Oh! The wool seems to be bumping me upwards?

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: That means our trip is about to begin.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: How's the view up there?

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Always great before the rain falls.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: And how are you feeling?

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: ...Always great before the rain falls.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: And you, Adele?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Hm, you seem to be in a good mood?
The petite critter follows them, skipping and hopping.
Along the street, the lights, the clouds and the stars, it tries its best to get higher and higher.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Wow... I think it's gotten stronger.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Will it come with us?
The fluffy critter doesn't answer, and she bites onto a corner of Adele's coat. Clink, clank, they step on the lights.
Adele feels as if she's flying. People are come and go on the street—no, it is sheep that are moving to and fro.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: ——Oh! Be careful, you might run into someone.

steps.name: Merry Creature
steps.text: They're selling flowers up ahead! I need to hurry.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: No need to rush still, your rainbow is all crooked. Here, let me help you straighten it.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Alright, off you go.

steps.name: Merry Creature
steps.text: Thank you, see you, so long!
Little Black Sheep shuffle through the streets one after another, going in and out of shops. The streets at night have taken on a different look.

Adele turns her head to look for her two companions who were separated by the waves of Little Black Sheep. As soon as she turns, she is greeted by the sight of two fluffy creatures quietly standing right behind her.
It is as if they have been waiting here for countless years.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Adele, you have to plant a pebble when you return this time.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: A pebble?

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Yes, just like we did with a small hunk of rock before.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: We buried it in the ground, which was originally in a very dark shade, until it met many different kinds of rocks.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Let me guess. Because you bought a lot of 'luck' for it?
The two fluffy critters continue jumping upwards, towards the sky, seeming more distant than ever.
Adele stands in between, her hands outstretched holding onto their wool.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Well... that is one reason, but the important bit is that I water it with 'love' everyday.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: And 'memories.'

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Can you buy those in shops too?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: No, little one. 'Love' and 'memories' are our own treasures.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: They will grow on the paths you tread, in your embraces, and on the cheeks you kiss.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: But sometimes they go unnoticed, so we always have to work hard to find them.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: That little stone traveled through many mountains underground, and followed the rivers through many a place.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Knocking and bumping into things, and finally we realized, we had no idea where it had gone. We lost it.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Then, are you two... sad because of that?

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: We feel regret.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Perhaps we shouldn't have planted it, or maybe we should have planted it somewhere we could see.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Every little stone is unique, and we lost what was ours.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: But I recall that it turned into lava in the end, warm and piping hot, and we all loved it.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Yes, we loved it.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Then, that's all right... It managed to turn into lava in the end, and you didn't forget it.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I think this little stone was already fortunate enough.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Maybe it's a dream. A dream, a story.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: A story circling in my head, that needed us to tell you about it.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Then, if you ever meet this rock again one day, do you think you'll be able to recognize it?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Adele, my little rascal.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Will we still recognize it?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: No, it has already turned into beautiful lava. Red hot lava rushing forward, never to look back again.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: We will never ever meet it again, we will only be at its back.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: It will go to places we have never been, to see sights we have never seen.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: And all we need is to remember this story, to tell it to you. You'll also have to plant your own little pebble, and then watch it take root and sprout, watch it go far away.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Look, Adele. We've reached the peak.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: The little stones have already turned into lava. The eruption is about to begin.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Is this story about to end too?

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Not at all, this is just the beginning.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: It will turn into a cloud, and then fall back to the ground.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: It will no longer be a rock, but a handful of warm and white volcanic ash.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: It is the little stones turning into nutritious volcanic ash that allows the land to bloom.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Our little stone will return. Someday, when that happens, we'll be able to see it again.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Will that be a long time, or will it be soon...?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Maybe we don't know.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Come, Adele. Hold onto me, we too will turn into clouds, and then fall back to the earth.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: We're going to fly down together.
Adele hugs the creature by her side, and tries making a step—
She falls downwards, but it is slow and light, as if she is floating.
She sees her hair flying around her, the other Little Black Sheep lightly jumping around the lights of the shops.
The wool on her body holds her up, enveloping her. An experience already in the depths of her childhood memories, her parents hold her up, and throw her into the sky to catch the stars above.
She falls onto the wool, fluffy and soft beneath her. The stars fall into her eyes, and her eyes grow hot.
Shadows come and go on the street, and Adele tries to get on her feet, wanting to share this fantastic feeling with the two fluffy creatures by her side.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Phew... I...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Where are we going next?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I spotted many more little shops in the distance when we were above earlier. Should we go around and take a look?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'll go look for places where we can find more bottle caps, so we can buy more of the things we want.
Adele's breathing quickens with her excitement.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The Little Black Sheep from earlier mentioned a flower shop just ahead. My mother used to always place some flowers by my bed when I was young. Do you like flowers?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Those small and white flowers, that look like you two.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Look, just like the one on that Little Black Sheep.
The fluffy creatures fall silent, no longer replying.
The stars in the sky dim, and then light up as they open their mouths.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Little one...

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: I know, the bedside flowers do smell really good. I love them too.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Then I'll buy some and make garlands for you!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Just wait for me here, I haven't made one in a long time, I...
The remainder of Adele's words choke in her throat. She realizes the fluffy critters have stopped following her, the flowers and leaves from her staff fluttering around the two.
They take a few steps back, their figures melting into the night.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: No, Adele. We have to go.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: The clouds have gathered, and will never again disperse.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Yes. It's time.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: We have to head back up the volcano before it starts to rain.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Up the volcano.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Don't go to the volcano... you'll...

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: No, Adele. The rain will soon fall.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: If we don't go, everything we've done before will be for naught.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: You will drown if you stay somewhere low.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Adele, you have to go to the peak.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: It has a beautiful view, and also the truth.

steps.name: Solemn Creature
steps.text: Adele, I hope that you can stay pure and focused.

a.text: This land is not at all pure, but there shouldn't be anything disturbing the heart of someone keen for answers.
We want to expand the boundaries of what humanity knows, together with you.
We're working our hardest for this reason, and you'll definitely stand on our shoulders to see a clearer and lovelier land.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Adele...

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: So long, Adele.
